phase_2_policy_comparison.core_scientific_question: Is the confirmatory benchmark evaluating Dynamic Spectral Guidance (DSG) on the audio distribution as packaged and released by Mozilla Common Voice 27.0, or is the dissertation asserting that every recording is provably complete relative to its uncompressed original capture?

level_1_current_file_structural_integrit.dimension: Current-File Structural Validity Through Observed EOF
level_1_current_file_structural_integrit.technical_definition: All available recording files passed the documented MPEG structural checks through their observed file boundaries (valid frame sync headers 0xFFE/0xFFF to EOF, uncorrupted frame synchronization, and complete physical container structure). This does not establish completeness relative to an original recording session or master recording.

level_2_full_file_decoder_pcm_success.technical_definition: Multi-decoder decompression (SoundFile, PyAV, miniaudio) yielding complete, finite floating-point PCM sample arrays without decoding errors or aborts.

level_3_completeness_relative_to_origina.dimension: Completeness Relative to Original Masters (Claim B)
level_3_completeness_relative_to_origina.technical_definition: Absence of upstream audio shortening or client-side truncation relative to the uncompressed original microphone capture prior to MP3 compression.
level_3_completeness_relative_to_origina.empirical_status: UNVERIFIED FOR ALL 18,975 RECORDINGS (Authoritative original masters are unavailable in Common Voice 27.0)

level_4_recording_stage_acoustic_clippin.technical_definition: Saturation or non-linear distortion occurring at the contributor's physical microphone diaphragm or ADC during the physical recording event.
level_4_recording_stage_acoustic_clippin.empirical_status: PHYSICALLY IRRECOVERABLE (Cannot be disproven even if an uncompressed master were available)

phase_2_policy_comparison.evidentiary_status_statement: Current-file structural integrity and PCM decoding have been evaluated using the documented validation procedures. Original-source completeness relative to the uncompressed master recordings remains unverified for all 18,975 recordings because authoritative master references are unavailable. The 130 quarantined recordings additionally have documented duration-estimation discrepancies, which are not, by themselves, proof of physical truncation.
phase_2_policy_comparison.negative_evidentiary_boundary: Clean decoding and current-file integrity do NOT prove complete original recording capture or zero recording truncation. An audio file can decode cleanly to PCM even if audio was previously shortened at a valid MPEG frame boundary prior to distribution. Under Policy 2A, the dissertation explicitly discloses that Claim B remains unverified across all 18,975 recordings.

claim_a_physical_integrity.definition: Current-file structural validity through observed EOF: all available recording files passed documented MPEG structural checks through their observed file boundaries (valid sync headers 0xFFE/0xFFF to EOF, 0 trailing bytes) and clean PCM decodability. This does not establish completeness relative to an original recording session or master recording.
claim_a_physical_integrity.evidence_base: All 18,975 recordings decode cleanly to PCM without bitstream or sync errors (100.0% verified).

claim_b_original_source_completeness.definition: Verification against uncompressed original microphone recordings that no upstream clipping or client-side truncation occurred prior to MP3 export.
claim_b_original_source_completeness.evidence_base: Common Voice 27.0 does not distribute uncompressed originals or authoritative master duration references (0 / 18,975).

historical_pyav_decoder_discrepancy_reso.fixture_characteristics: 16,200 bytes; 77 complete physical MPEG frames (88,704 samples capacity); partial 78th frame truncated by 100 bytes (109 of 209 bytes available).
historical_pyav_decoder_discrepancy_reso.original_failure_in_task_772a: In Task 7.7.2A, libmpg123 (SoundFile) and dr_mp3 (miniaudio) failed closed on the incomplete final frame, discarding the 109-byte partial frame and decoding exactly 88,704 samples (77 complete frames). In contrast, PyAV (FFmpeg 7.1 / libavcodec) accepted Packet 77 containing 109 trailing bytes and decoded a 78th frame of 1,152 samples (total 89,856 samples), emitting 1,152 more samples than the physical capacity of complete frames. Task 7.7.2A recorded this as unresolved_decoder_mechanism_status: 'PyAV produced 1,152 more samples than the capacity of the complete physical MPEG frames. The precise decoder mechanism responsible has not been conclusively established.'
historical_pyav_decoder_discrepancy_reso.corrective_investigation_and_resolution: The anomaly was traced to libavcodec's error-resilience and bit-reservoir parser logic on truncated trailing packets at EOF, where libavcodec attempts decoding rather than raising a fatal error. Crucially, this behavior was strictly confined to an intentionally truncated synthetic test fixture (Case 7). Forensic structural audits in Task 7.7.1 and Task 7.7.2A established that ZERO natural Common Voice recordings in Cohort 3 suffer from mid-frame truncation or incomplete final frames. Every single one of the 18,975 natural recordings (both the 18,845 accepted and the 130 quarantined files) terminates at complete physical MPEG frame boundaries with 0 trailing bytes through observed EOF.

historical_pyav_decoder_discrepancy_reso.accurate_disclosure: The decoder anomaly's relevance to the natural evaluation cohort was investigated and bounded. The different decoder behavior on the synthetic mid-frame-truncated fixture remains a documented edge case. The internal C-level decoding mechanism of libavcodec on truncated synthetic trailing packets remains unresolved as originally documented in Task 7.7.2A. However, because no natural Common Voice recording in the 18,975 corpus has truncated trailing packets, this synthetic condition does not affect the natural audio corpus, where all three decoders successfully decompress 100% of the 18,975 recordings without error.

policies.name: Strict Mandatory Claim B (Original-Source Completeness) Prerequisite
policies.exact_admission_criteria: A recording is admitted into the confirmatory benchmark IF AND ONLY IF its original-source completeness (Claim B) is independently verified against an authoritative external master recording or contributor-certified utterance duration reference.
policies.claim_a_status: Satisfied for all 18,975 recordings, but insufficient for admission under Claim B prerequisite.
policies.claim_b_status: Unverified across 100.0% of recordings (0 authoritative references).
scientific_advantages: Epistemically unimpeachable: eliminates all risk of evaluating recordings that experienced client-side truncation.
Enforces absolute fidelity to the ideal capture target.
Prevents any scientific criticism regarding unverified upstream audio provenance.
scientific_limitations: Complete execution block: Stage 6M confirmatory evaluation cannot proceed.
Requires acquiring 18,975 uncompressed microphone master recordings from Mozilla, which Common Voice does not collect or archive.
Renders the entire Common Voice 27.0 corpus unusable for confirmatory benchmark testing.

policies.name: Pure Claim A Physical Bitstream Admission (Decoupled Decodability)
policies.exact_admission_criteria: A recording is admitted under PROTOCOL_ADMIT_ORIGIN_UNVERIFIED IF AND ONLY IF it satisfies all current-file physical MPEG bitstream and PCM decodability criteria: (1) all MPEG audio frames complete to EOF; (2) bitstream sync words intact without loss; (3) complete PCM stream decodes without error; (4) sampling rate and channels valid. Claim B is explicitly documented as unverified for all 18,975 recordings. Gate 1 authorizes solely the scientific admission criteria and target dataset definition; Task 7.7.4 materializer implementation and execution require separate Gate 2 authorization.
policies.physical_storage_separation_note: Under Policy 2A, all 18,975 recordings are logically admitted as Common Voice assets, while the 130 discrepancy-screened recordings remain physically in the quarantine directory (cohort3_rejected_quarantine). Those are two different concepts. The 130 files carry the explicit admission disposition ADMITTED_ORIGIN_UNVERIFIED_WITH_DURATION_DISCREPANCY, retaining their original physical location until a separate Gate 2 authorization permits any materialization operation. This avoids accidentally suggesting that the 130 recordings are excluded from the research population merely because they remain in quarantine.
policies.claim_a_status: Fully verified (STRUCTURAL_PASS, PCM_DECODE_CLEAN) for 100% of files.
policies.claim_b_status: Explicitly ORIGIN_UNVERIFIED across all 18,975 files (transparently documented).
scientific_advantages: Fully restores and preserves the registered balanced Section 14.7 five-stratum design (N_g = 220, C = 15).
The approved Task 6.3 statistical power result (90.58% joint power, one-sided 95% LCB = 90.085739%) strictly applies to this registered design.
Eliminates an uncalibrated, empirical container size heuristic (1,152 samples) that misclassifies bitstream-intact files as corrupt.
Evaluates model robustness on real-world Common Voice audio as distributed in standard speech research.
Strictly maintains role separation: 1,100 eval speakers vs 100 gate speakers vs 65 reserve speakers.
scientific_limitations: Cannot assert original-source completeness: whole-frame upstream truncation prior to MP3 export cannot be ruled out for any of the 18,975 recordings.
Requires explicit methodological disclosure in the dissertation that benchmark inference is conditional on Common Voice 27.0 distribution integrity.
policies.protocol_amendment_required: Minor protocol addendum: formally adopt the four-level taxonomy, register the status PROTOCOL_ADMIT_ORIGIN_UNVERIFIED for all 18,975 recordings, and keep Gate 1 separated from Gate 2.
policies.power_status: Approved 90.58% power result (LCB_95 = 90.085739% >= 90.0%) applies conditionally to the registered design. Does NOT guarantee real-world DSG efficacy; margin is +0.0857 pp (+8 trajectories).

policies.name: Decoupled Physical Validation with Estimation Discrepancy Screen
policies.exact_admission_criteria: A recording is admitted if it passes Claim A physical checks AND has container duration shortfall Delta = soundfile_declared_pcm_frames - decoded_pcm_frames <= 1152 PCM sample frames. Recordings with Delta > 1152 sample frames are held in diagnostic quarantine under ADMISSION_HOLD as empirical estimation anomalies.
policies.claim_a_status: Verified for all 18,975 files; 130 files held despite passing Claim A.
policies.claim_b_status: Unverified across all 18,975 files (both admitted and held).
scientific_advantages: Maintains complete consistency with the historical production validator's 1,152-sample shortfall cutoff.
Conservatively screens out recordings where container size metadata diverges from decoded PCM by > 1 frame.
Leaves all 18,845 baseline files completely untouched and immediately eligible.
scientific_limitations: Quarantines 130 physically intact, cleanly decodable recordings based on container heuristics rather than bitstream corruption.
Breaks the balanced N_g = 220 design across 13 evaluation speakers (4 empty clusters, 9 partial clusters).
Under Option A (complete clusters only), reduces evaluation cohort to 1,087 speakers with cross-stratum sample size imbalance (N_g in [215, 220]).
Under Option B (unequal clusters), introduces variable cluster sizes C_i in [1, 14], altering variance structure and estimand definitions.
INVALIDATES the approved 90.58% statistical power result; strictly requires commissioning a new Monte Carlo power study.
policies.protocol_amendment_required: Substantive protocol amendment: register the 1,152-sample discrepancy screening rule, formalize either Option A or Option B, and register updated sample size, stratum balance, and power targets.
policies.power_status: CANNOT INHERIT 90.58% POWER; new Monte Carlo power simulation study strictly required.

threshold_audit.discrepancy_vs_truncation_distinction: In CBR MP3 bitstreams without Xing/Info headers, non-audio container bytes (such as ID3 metadata) inflate the total file size, causing container parsers (libsndfile) to calculate declared frames exceeding actual decoded PCM frames. A non-zero Delta represents an estimation discrepancy, NOT evidence that the audio bitstream was physically truncated at EOF or that samples were dropped.

power_and_estimand_distinctions.clarification: Under Policy 2A, the registered sample size (N_g = 220, C = 15) is fully preserved. The approved Task 6.3 calibrated power result (90.58%, LCB_95 = 90.085739%) remains formally applicable to this registered design. However, this power is conditional on simulation assumptions and does not guarantee observed empirical DSG efficacy. The margin above 90.0% is slender (+0.0857 pp / +8 trajectories).

Statistical power under Policy 2B (under both Option A and Option B) is formally UNVERIFIED and UNKNOWN. Informal conjecture intervals are retracted. A dedicated Monte Carlo power re-simulation is mandatory.

Unequal cluster sizes alter the variance structure of the cluster estimator and potentially the target estimand (e.g. speaker-level average WER vs utterance-level average WER). The bootstrap resampling procedure must be explicitly specified and validated for variable cluster sizes.

primary_estimand_aggregation_analysis.core_issue: In speech recognition evaluation, the level of metric aggregation determines how partial clusters contribute to the primary performance and fairness statistics. Three candidate aggregation levels exist.

aggregation_levels.weighting_behavior: Weights each word equally. Speakers with longer sentences or more clips have proportional influence.
aggregation_levels.balanced_design_status: Secondary descriptive metric; distinct from speaker-fairness contrast.
aggregation_levels.option_b_impact: Complete speakers with 15 clips exert ~15x more influence than 1-clip speakers, confounding speaker-level acoustic benefits with utterance volume.

aggregation_levels.balanced_design_status: Distinct from pooled speaker-macro: weights clips equally (1/15 per clip), whereas pooled speaker-macro weights clips by their reference-word fractions (N_sc / W_s). They are equal IF AND ONLY IF all clips have identical reference-word counts, which does not hold in natural speech.
aggregation_levels.option_b_impact: A speaker with 1 clip contributes 1/15th as much to the stratum WER as a speaker with 15 clips. Violates equal speaker weighting.

aggregation_levels.formula: WER_speaker = (1/S) * sum_s ( sum_c Errors_sc / sum_c Words_sc )
aggregation_levels.weighting_behavior: Weights each speaker equally (1/S), pooling errors and words per speaker (Approach 2).
aggregation_levels.balanced_design_status: Prespecified Primary Inferential Estimand in registered Section 14.7 protocol.
aggregation_levels.option_b_impact: A partial speaker with fewer clips has a less precisely estimated speaker-level outcome. The variance difference depends on the number of clips, clip-level variation and within-speaker correlation, and must be represented in the power simulation.

primary_estimand_aggregation_analysis.mathematical_non_identity_derivation: Under pooled speaker WER (Approach 2), WER_s = sum_c E_sc / sum_c N_sc = sum_c (N_sc / W_s) * WER_sc. Speaker-Macro WER is WER_speaker = (1/S) * sum_s sum_c (N_sc / W_s) * WER_sc. Clip-Macro WER is WER_clip = (1/S) * sum_s sum_c (1/C) * WER_sc. As mathematical aggregation operators (functions over all possible clip WER vectors), these two estimands are identical functions IF AND ONLY IF N_sc / W_s = 1/C for all clips, meaning every clip has the exact same reference word count N_sc = W_s / C. While accidental numerical equality can theoretically occur on a single realized dataset through fortuitous cancellation (sum_c (N_sc / W_s - 1/C) * WER_sc = 0), they are fundamentally distinct mathematical estimands with different weighting structures. In natural speech corpora (such as Common Voice), sentence lengths vary widely (e.g. 2 to 20 words). Therefore, balanced clip counts (C=15) do NOT make speaker-macro functionally identical to clip-macro.

primary_estimand_aggregation_analysis.design_consequence: Under Policy 2A (balanced design, N_g=220, C=15), every speaker receives strictly equal weight (1/S = 1/220 per stratum) in the registered Section 14.7 estimand (Approach 2 pooled errors / pooled reference words). However, pooled speaker-macro and clip-macro are NOT mathematically identical because natural speech clips vary in word count (N_sc != W_s / 15). The registered Section 14.7 protocol explicitly prespecifies Speaker-Macro over Pooled Speaker WERs, preserving equal speaker weighting without small-denominator distortion from single short clips. Under Policy 2B Option B (unequal clusters C_i in [1, 15]), the primary estimand is mathematically ambiguous until explicitly pre-registered, and requires a dedicated power re-simulation using the chosen aggregation weights.
primary_estimand_aggregation_analysis.multiplicity_architecture_note: All confirmatory inferences are evaluated under the frozen Section 14.7 Bonferroni multiplicity framework: M = 8 simultaneous one-sided hypotheses, alpha_family = 0.05, alpha_adjusted = 0.00625, and simultaneous Upper Confidence Bound percentile = 99.375% (Event A: static UCB < 0.00 pp; Event B: ungated UCB < 0.00 pp; Event C: 5 accent regression UCBs <= +2.00 pp; Event D: disparity bootstrap 99.375th percentile UCB <= 0.00 pp). The calibrated 90.58% joint power result was computed under this exact M = 8 simultaneous 99.375% criterion.

phase_5_governance_and_repository_status.staging_ownership_specification: To guard against PID reuse and delayed heartbeats, staging directories (.staging_run_{run_id}/) are protected by dedicated lockfiles (run.lock) held under OS-level exclusive locking (msvcrt.locking / fcntl.flock). Orphan recovery sweeps require acquiring the exclusive OS lock plus verifying that heartbeat TTL > 3,600s and PID is terminated. A PID and heartbeat check alone is NOT sufficient to authorize deletion.
phase_5_governance_and_repository_status.storage_vs_admission_separation: Under Policy 2A, recordings are admitted under PROTOCOL_ADMIT_ORIGIN_UNVERIFIED. However, the 130 files physically remain located in datasets/external/common_voice_27/cohort3_rejected_quarantine for forensic isolation and evidentiary traceability until any future authorized, audited migration or promotion pipeline is executed. Admitting a file as a dataset asset does not imply premature manual movement or promotion.
